L2701

This regex pattern may catastrophically backtrack on certain inputs.

What

This regex pattern may catastrophically backtrack on certain inputs.

Why

A regex with unbounded quantifiers nested inside another unbounded quantifier can run in exponential time on adversarial inputs, causing a denial-of-service. Reserved for future `core.regex` patterns.

Fix

Anchor the pattern at the start (`^`) or end (`$`), or restructure it to avoid nested quantifiers.
